write_tools.run_command: WRITES: runs a shell command in /work, which can change any file there
write_tools.start_job: WRITES: starts a shell command in the background in /work, which can change any file there
write_tools.run_tests: WRITES: runs the project's tests (the project's own code), which can change files in /work
write_tools.stop_job: stops a background job and every process it started
